retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated high-fashion portrait featuring tribal-inspired makeup, feathered textures, and heavy geometric typography with vertical line motifs.
excludeWhen: vibrant high-saturation color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, desaturated female portrait with gold and white tribal face paint, characterized by five long black vertical lines descending from one eye. The subject wears a voluminous white feathered collar and a metallic spiked necklace, set against a background of faint handwritten script and smoky textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical lines from the eye echoing the vertical strokes in the typography
Feathered texture contrasting with the sharp metallic necklace
Desaturated skin tones against high-contrast black and white graphic elements
Handwritten background script providing a soft texture behind the sharp foreground subject
coreInvariants: Five parallel vertical black lines extending from the lower eyelid to the bottom of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium close-up portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one with the vertical line graphic.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, follows the vertical lines downward, then moves to the top-right typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with feathers, hair, and background script.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated cream and pale skin tones (Background/Subject)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black (Graphic lines and typography shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and silver (Face paint and jewelry)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black graphics and white highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy use of vertical inline patterns
Uniform stroke weight with internal decorative stripping
characterSpecificRedesigns: A is rendered as a solid triangle with an inline gap
E features elongated horizontal bars with vertical hatching
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric display face paired with a clean, thin sans-serif for secondary info and messy handwriting for texture.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a desaturated portrait of a woman with blonde hair, wearing a white feathered collar and metallic spiked necklace. Apply gold and white tribal paint to the face. Add a background of faint, messy white handwritten script and grey smoke.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply five solid black vertical lines from the left eye to the bottom edge. Place large, geometric, inline-textured uppercase text in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly five vertical lines from the eye?
Is the typography right-aligned and geometric?
Is the color palette desaturated with gold accents?
Is the background script legible as texture but not as primary content?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title text
Exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Generic 'tribal' tropes without modern fashion context

recipe.reuseFormula: Desaturated Portrait + Tribal Face Paint + Vertical Eye Lines + Geometric Inline Typography + Handwritten Texture Background
